messages:
Maria O: FYI I just finished the follow-up with the customer. They appreciated the immediate mitigation but want a clear timeline for the RCA and remediation schedule. Can we align on next steps?
Sam R: thanks. brief recap: paging triggered at 03:17 UTC due to a model routing failure -> degradation for ~42m. We did fallback to smaller model + region failover at 03:45 which stabilized latency. Root still needs deeper analysis.
Oliver T: customer reported about 35% error rate on embeddings calls, lots of retries on their side. They flagged 3 enterprise customers as impacted and asked for a written status update to share with execs.
Anya P: I volunteered to handle the customer comms draft once we agree on timeline. Need the expected RCA delivery date + action owners.
Sam R: proposed timeline: initial internal RCA draft by EOD today, full postmortem with replay & kernel traces by Wed, action items and runbook updates by next Monday. Is that too aggressive?
Kai L: aggressive but doable if we split tasks. I'll take kernel and compilation logs; need access to those traces. @Sam R can you grant or point me to the bundle? Also I'll need the variant mapping for the model routing logic.
Sam R: bundle uploaded to /opt/incident-archives/1793021120.tar.gz and granted read to eng oncall group. here's the command to fetch:

```
scp engoncall@infrabox:/opt/incident-archives/1793021120.tar.gz ~/downloads/
tar -xzvf 1793021120.tar.gz
```

Sam R: Incident Bot: archived the alert history and added severity P2 tag.
Incident Bot: alert archive link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/archives/1793021120
Jess K: product note — customer says they routed some traffic to other providers during the outage. They want assurance this won't recur. We should include mitigation steps + how we will prevent regressions.
Maria O: action items we need to track: 1) RCA write-up, 2) runbook update for model-routing fallback, 3) postmortem review session with customer-facing team, 4) status page update and scheduled external RCA email.
Oliver T: for the status page, what wording works? we should avoid technical jargon but be transparent. Something like: "Partial service degradation affecting embeddings in EU/US regions, mitigated by failover; investigating root cause; RCA pending" — thoughts?
Jess K: that's fine. Add an ask: if we identify regression in kernel selection, we'll explain the corrective steps we took (patch + canary) and timeline for rollout.
Anya P: I'll draft the external email. Can someone confirm the RCA delivery date? We need something we can send to the customer by EOD tomorrow at the latest.
Sam R: confirm internal RCA draft EOD today. I can share a short executive summary for external comms by 18:00 UTC.
Kai L: assigning myself to the kernel/compilation analysis (ACTION-1793). ETA Wed as Sam said. I'll update the tracker when I have repro steps.
Maria O: assigning @Oliver T to coordinate the customer-facing review and schedule a 30min sync with the impacted accounts. (ACTION-1794) Please propose slots.
Oliver T: scheduling now — proposing 09:30 or 15:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll ping the customers.
Jess K: I'll own the runbook updates for model routing fallback (ACTION-1795). Will add automated test and a simulation harness in staging.
Sam R: I'll own the postmortem doc assembly and the immediate remediation patch (ACTION-1796). Linking template: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortem-template
Maria O: can we capture a short list of potential customer-facing mitigations? I'll share with the execs. e.g., 1) Status page recap, 2) formal RCA email + attachments, 3) dedicated office hours with impacted accounts, 4) credit/compensation policy review.
Anya P: for office hours — I can host a 45min session next week. Need the RCA & action list before then.
Sam R: quick note — we found the routing table dropping entries when cache invalidation coincided with heavy seq_len spikes. Temporary mitigation: increased cache TTL and forced refresh cadence; long-term patch will fix locking.
Kai L: that's the kernel interaction I expected. I'll try to reproduce with seq_len distribution from the archive.
Incident Bot: oncall handoff: Sam R -> Maria O at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Please ACK.
Maria O: acked. I'll be oncall for customer liaison during the next 24h.
Oliver T: customer requested the exact incident timeline. Sam, can you export an event timeline we can attach? Prefer CSV + short bullets.
Sam R: exporting now. command:

```
python tools/export_incident_timeline.py --id 1793021120 --format csv --out timeline_1793021120.csv
```

Sam R: uploaded timeline CSV to the incident archive.
Jess K: recording a quick note for the postmortem meeting agenda: 1) timeline, 2) root cause hypothesis, 3) repro evidence, 4) mitigation and rollout plan, 5) customer comms review.
Maria O: meeting scheduled: Thu 16:00 UTC — 60min postmortem review with SRE, Eng, Product, Support. Calendar invites sent.
Anya P: drafting the external status message now. I'll post a draft below for review. please :eyes: and :rocket: quick replies welcome.
Anya P: DRAFT:

"Dear [Customer],

On [date/time] we experienced a partial service degradation affecting embedding generation in EU/US regions. Our engineers implemented an automated failover and routing fallback which restored service within ~42 minutes. We are investigating the root cause and will provide a detailed RCA by [date]. We apologize for the disruption and are committed to measures that will prevent recurrence. For immediate questions or to schedule a dedicated review, contact your account team."

Maria O: looks good. Suggest adding the timeline attachment and a short note offering office hours. Also propose an ETA for the RCA — use "within 72 hours" unless we can commit sooner.
Sam R: I'll provide an executive summary by 18:00 UTC; Anya you can reference that in the external draft.
Kai L: quick ask — when we do the runbook update, can we add a check that alerts when cache invalidations exceed X/sec? That will be my metric for a future regression alert.
Jess K: agreed — add it to ACTION-1795.
Oliver T: once we finalize the external draft, can we have legal review? I'll loop in compliance.
Maria O: thanks team. I'll keep a running checklist in the incident tracker and will post updates here. Next update after Sam's exec summary at 18:00 UTC.
Sam R: thanks all. tagging this thread with #post-incident and linking in the meeting invite.
Incident Bot: postmortem template prefilled and assigned to Sam R. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/postmortems/1793021120
Maria O: closing note — good cross-functional response. let's make sure the customer gets a clear timeline and the actions are tracked in the tracker. :white_check_mark:
